turns.prompt_text: I have a different D50 printer as well I've installed the app to use it can you open that application
turns.response_html:
I am unable to open the "D50 printer" application on your device because it is not installed. Based on my search, the D50 printer uses an app called "Print Master".

Here is the link to the official website and Play Store:

  • Official website: https://phomemo.com/pages/phomemo-mobile-download
  • Play Store link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.project.aimotech.printmaster
